title: Autocomplete with a trie
description:
Suggest words that start with what was typed.

```
words: car card care careful cat dog dot
"car" -> car card care careful
"do"  -> dog dot
"x"   -> (nothing)
```
hints: Walk down to the node for the prefix, then collect words with a recursive function that adds one letter per level (lesson 6.04).
Visiting children in order `a` to `z` gives alphabetical results for free.
requirements: A trie node has 26 child pointers (`std::unique_ptr`) and an "ends a word" flag.
`insert`, `startsWith(prefix)` returning all words in alphabetical order.
Lower-case letters only; ignore other words.
stretch: Limit suggestions to the 3 most used words, with a count stored in each node.
